english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a place where cars are parked, whether outdoors or in a building.

examples.english: There are still spaces in this car park at night.
examples.traditional: 呢個停車場夜晚都仲有位。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 ting4 ce1 coeng4 je6 maan5 dou1 zung6 jau5 wai6
